key.name: clock-x
key.description: Horizontal position of the clock widget on screen.

key.name: clock-y
key.description: Vertical position of the clock widget on screen.

key.name: clock-scale
key.description: Zoom level of the entire clock (0.3 – 5.0).

key.name: day-color
key.description: CSS color for the day-of-week label.

key.name: date-color
key.description: CSS color for the date label.

key.name: time-color
key.description: CSS color for the time label.

key.name: font-family
key.description: Font family used for the day-of-week label.

key.name: clock-opacity
key.description: Master opacity for the entire clock widget (0.0 – 1.0).

key.name: show-seconds
key.description: Whether to include seconds in the time display.
